title: Frontend: Project card component — name, type badge, progress bar, points/level, last updated
description: Create the ProjectCard component that summarizes a project in a clickable card format for the dashboard grid.
acceptanceCriteria: Card shows: project name, type badge (colored by type), progress bar (uses progressManual if set, else progressAuto), points total, level badge, last updated relative time
Card is clickable and navigates to /projects/:id
Type badge colors: software=blue, design=purple, physical=orange, content=green, learning=yellow, other=gray
Progress bar fills from left to right with color indicating progress level

steps.details: Create src/components/projects/ProjectCard.tsx. Accept project as prop. Wrap in a link to /projects/:id. Use shadcn/ui Card, Badge, Progress components. Display effective progress = progressManual ?? progressAuto. Use date-fns formatDistanceToNow for last updated.
Create utility function getTypeColor(type): string that returns Tailwind color classes per type. Create getStatusVariant(status): Badge variant. Apply to shadcn/ui Badge components.
Render dashboard with multiple project types. Verify each card shows correct data. Verify clicking card navigates to project detail.
